$comment: A coaching guide asset: small validated frontmatter plus fixed prose sections. Guides are package assets under scripts/weave_quality/guides/ with .weave/guides/ overrides, resolved deterministically and never templated — no Jinja, no executable Markdown, no runner escape hatch. Guide prose is versioned independently of detector rules: a wording change must never stale a scan receipt or move a promotion identity.

id.$comment: Must equal the file's basename with any .<language> suffix and the .md extension removed. The leading underscore is reserved for the three presentation guides.

violation_type.$comment: The catalogued type this guide coaches, or the literal '_presentation' for _clean/_incomplete/_uncoached, which coach a response state rather than a violation.

language.$comment: Set only on a language variant. Must equal the .<language> segment of the filename.

sections.$comment: The fixed section order every surface renders. `why` and `corrective_move` are required because a guide that cannot say what is wrong or what to do instead is not coaching. `avoid` is optional but strongly expected on any guide whose detector can be satisfied without fixing anything — the reader is usually an agent.

resolution.$comment: Deterministic, with no plugin axis. The first hit wins; there is no merging across layers. A project override that fails frontmatter or section validation is NOT skipped in favour of the package guide — it fails closed with a guide_override_invalid cause, because silently preferring the package copy would hide a broken override indefinitely.

flat.$comment: No subdirectories: both installer paths enumerate the guides directory non-recursively.

language_suffix.$comment: Why a catalogued guide basename may never contain a dot: a dotted basename is indistinguishable from a language variant.
